tools.name: get_service_status
tools.description: Service limits, storage policy, the caller's workspace ID (for privacy requests) and a summary of supplier health. Pass supplier_id for one supplier's tools, limits and last health record, or category for a compact list of that category's suppliers.

tools.name: find_sources
tools.description: Find suppliers and reference data; this never searches inventory. catalogue (default) lists reviewed suppliers, ten compact rows per page, filtered by category, query or connected. award_programs lists loyalty-program coverage and bank transfer relationships. booking_guide gives official booking ste

tools.name: get_supplier_tools
tools.description: Read one supplier's current tool names and input schemas before calling it through search_travel. freshness_policy=live_only leaves out cached and published-price tools.

tools.name: search_travel
tools.description: Search suppliers. Pass exactly one of: requirements (Goliath plans up to four requests; continue with plan_offset), searches (one to four explicit supplier/tool/arguments requests built from get_supplier_tools), or award_search (flexible-date award windows, served from cached sources). tools.name: compare_quotes
tools.description: Arithmetic on quotes you already have; it looks nothing up. cash (default) totals flight, stay and extra costs per traveler. findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_supplier_tools" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
